verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer ships client-facing software (a self-service Contract Generator, GDHQ, the D&O Questionnaire Portal, and the internal ChatGD), so bulk operations are a fair question here. Nothing in the evidence documents running one action across many items at once. ChatGD's ability to 'query and manipulate documents' and the contract generator's self-service flow describe single-item interactions, not batch processing. The probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, so there is no programmatic batch interface either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
